conjecture: Linear containers LinCont := Fam(Vec^op), objects (S,(P_s)), extension <<S,P>>W = (+)_{s} Vec(P_s,W): Vec->Vec. THREE PARTS. PART 1 (biproduct collapse, primary): Vec's terminal object is 0 so <<S,P>>(0)=0 and the Set slogan F(1)=S dies; for finite S and finite-dim positions <<S,P>> ~= Id^N with N=Sum dim P_s, so a finite linear container is classified by the single number N (partition invisible), unique by Krull-Schmidt since End(Id)=k. PART 2 (representation / extensivity crux): Nat(<<S,P>>,<<T,Q>>) = Prod_s (+)_t Vec(Q_t,P_s) while container-hom = Prod_s (disjoint-union)_t Vec(Q_t,P_s); the extension <<->> is NOT full, and the gap is exactly '(disjoint-union) proper-subset (+)' = the failure of extensivity of Vec (in Set the coproduct in the hom-formula IS the disjoint union, giving full faithfulness / the classical Diers representation theorem). PART 3 (comonoid probe): finite-dim composition (S,P)o(T,Q)=(SxT,(P_s(x)Q_t)), unit ({*},k); a o-comonoid collapses to a family of k-algebras (one shape = a k-algebra), NOT a full algebroid -- linearity kills the dependent-sum that would encode off-diagonal morphisms.

children.approach: Lemma 1.1: for a Vec-functor G, Nat(h_P,G) ~= G(P) (linear co-Yoneda via universal element id_P); so Nat(Id,G)=G(k), Nat(h_P,h_Q)=Vec(Q,P)
Lemma 1.2: h:Vec^op->[Vec,Vec] full faithful + additive (h_{P(+)Q}=h_P(+)h_Q); unique indecomposable corepresentable = h_k=Id; End(Id)=k
Lemma 1.3: dim P < infinity => Vec(P,(+)_t V_t) = (+)_t Vec(P,V_t) (f.d. image lands in finite subsum); fails for inf-dim P (h_P = infinite product)

Thm 2.1 (PART 1): S finite, positions f.d. => <<S,P>> ~= Id^N, N=Sum dim P_s; classified by N alone; Krull-Schmidt-Azumaya (End(Id)=k local) => decomposition Id^{(+)N} unique, recovers only N. Plus 2(a) terminal recovery fails <<S,P>>(0)=0, 2(c) survival regimes.
Thm 3.1-3.2: Nat(<<S,P>>,<<T,Q>>) = Prod_s (+)_t Vec(Q_t,P_s) (co-Yoneda); container-hom = Prod_s (disjoint-union)_t Vec(Q_t,P_s)

Thm 3.3 (PART 2, the crux): induced map on homs = (disjoint-union)_t ↪ (+)_t; NOT full whenever some s hits >=2 nonzero t. In Set the hom-formula coproduct IS the disjoint union => full faithful (classical). The lone change Set~>Vec is (disjoint-union) proper-subset (+) = failure of extensivity. Cor 3.4: finite recovery of (+)_s P_s up to iso, partition lost.

Prop 4.1 (PART 3, proved): finite-dim positions => (S,P)o(T,Q)=(SxT,(P_s(x)Q_t)), unit ({*},k); NOT the Set dependent sum Sum_s S^{P_s} (Lemma 1.3 + tensor-hom: linearity flattens the dependency to a plain product SxT).

Thm 7 (PART 3, PROVED 2026-08-19, upgrades Prop 4.2 computed->proved): o-comonoid in (Fam(Vec_fd^op),o,I) = family (A_s) of unital associative k-algebras, one per shape, NO cross-shape composition. Counit forces delta_shape=diagonal (unique (Set,x)-comonoid on S); contravariance => delta^#_s=mu_s:P_s(x)P_s->P_s (multiplication) and eps^#_s=eta_s:k->P_s (unit); counit laws <=> two-sided unit, coassoc <=> associativity. Comon_o(Fam(Vec_fd^op)) ~= Fam(Alg_k^op) (cocommutative = Fam(CAlg_k^op)). NEGATIVE HALF: shape-diagonal => delta never reaches off-diagonal block P_a(x)P_b (a!=b) => no hom-between-objects => a DISJOINT FAMILY OF ONE-OBJECT k-linear categories = k-algebras, NOT an algebroid. Refutes the crown 'o-comonoid over Vec = algebroid' guess in finite dim; the biproduct/linearity collapse (Prop 4.1 flattening Sum_s to x) is the mechanism. HYPOTHESES SHARPENED: finite-dim positions only, S ARBITRARY (finite S not needed). RESOLUTION of the negative-half open thread (2026-08-20 scoping, agent-verified H1-H4). The algebroid DOES appear once positions are DOUBLE-INDEXED: correct objects = Vec-enriched graphs / matrices of vspaces (S,(P_{a,b})_{S x S}); correct (lax/bimodule) composition = MATRIX product (P o Q)_{a,c} = (+)_b P_{a,b} (x) Q_{b,c} (the (+)_b restores the extensivity coproduct whose absence ∐⊊⊕ caused the strict collapse). Then a MONOID in Mat(Vec) = k-linear category = algebroid (hom(a,b)=P_{a,b}, composition (+)_b A(b,c)(x)A(a,b)->A(a,c)); via the fibrewise op, a COMONOID in Mat(Vec^op) = algebroid too (both ops cancel). The strict single-index o (S x T, P_s(x)Q_t) is the DIAGONAL DEGENERATION (P_{a,b}=0 for a!=b), which is exactly why the counit-forced shape-diagonal gave only a family of algebras.
